designGuide.imagesAndVideosUseGalleryTiles: Images and videos use gallery tiles. The whole tile opens the task gallery; files and links keep compact, fully clickable rows. Task/Artifact Gallery in Storybook covers playable videos, mixed files, narrow panels, and unavailable previews.
designGuide.eachBrowserAppearsOnceAtIts: Each browser appears once at its opening time among the task messages. Its status updates in place; the action opens its side-panel tab.
designGuide.fitToPaneFollowsTheVisible: Fit to pane follows the visible panel. Fixed viewport presets and session actions live in the footer menu. Costs stay in task reporting. The idle countdown appears only in the final five minutes. Full panel, activity, and settings states are in Storybook under Browser Use.
designGuide.uploadedTextOpensInANamed: Uploaded text opens in a named task tab. Markdown offers Rendered and Raw icon controls; every text file has a download action.
designGuide.compactVariantForEmbeddingInsideDialogs: Compact variant for embedding inside dialogs and modals.
designGuide.theLinkedIssueReachedATerminal: The linked issue reached a terminal state before a summary was written.
designGuide.itsBuiltInAgentWasPaused: Its built-in agent was paused 2 days ago, so new briefs aren't being generated.
designGuide.previewOnlyThisFieldDoesNot: Preview only. This field does not save or submit a credential.
designGuide.agentmailSetupHasTwoStepsPick: AgentMail setup has two steps: pick an agent, then pick an email address. Ask for the API key alongside the agent only when needed. Keep address errors beside the field and additional settings under Advanced options.
designGuide.theTaskCardIsTheDialog: The task card is the dialog host for the shared connection setup flow. Provider forms, validation, OAuth, access selection, and completion come from the same feature module as the full-page Apps setup; this card owns only audience, dialog, and task refresh behavior. Pending connections stay in the timeline beside a usable composer. The independently addressable Connections/In-task connections stories cover access, OAuth recovery, narrow layouts, completion, and historical outcomes. AgentMail uses an inline API-key field with fixed access defaults; its field and direct key-page link are shared with Apps setup.
designGuide.forANamedRecipientPassThe: For a named recipient, pass the optional agent name and logo. The same copy feedback, preview, and manual clipboard recovery apply.
designGuide.useAgentsetuppromptForPromptsHandedTo: Use AgentSetupPrompt for prompts handed to an external agent: connections, webhook setup, onboarding, and task handoffs. One click copies the complete prompt, opens its preview, and confirms success inline; clipboard failures offer selectable text.
designGuide.chooseAnAgentYouAlreadyUse: Escolha um agente que você já usa.
designGuide.matchTheHarnessPickerWithProvider: Match the harness picker with provider cards. Connection checks reflect confirmed server evidence. AnimatedDialogContent resizes to its content using motion tokens and respects reduced motion.
designGuide.recoveryRunsInTheBackgroundTask: Recovery runs in the background. Task lists keep their ordinary status without execution badges. Active transcript headers keep saying Working during automatic recovery. Recovery decisions and attempts belong in the run log; there is no execution status card or reconciliation form.
designGuide.aDecisionCardSitsAboveThe: A decision card sits above the ordinary message composer. Dismiss the card to keep a reopen control, or resolve it to clear the pending state.
designGuide.storybookSRecoveryNoticeStoriesShow: Storybook’s Recovery notice stories show the actionable, pending, acknowledged, unavailable, failed, and mobile states using this production component.
designGuide.loadingErrorsEmptySearchMobileAnd: Loading, errors, empty search, mobile, and short viewports are covered in the Project repos Storybook stories.
designGuide.theSharedFiletreeExplorerLayoutPuts: The shared FileTree explorer layout puts disclosure controls beside selection, with compact folder chains, equal-height rows, inline skill descriptions, and trailing status badges. Folders select descendant packages; package checkboxes select only that package, independently of nested skills. Included files use aligned rows without individual checkboxes (`getCheckboxState` returns null); package rows use `renderNodeExtra` for file counts and inspection. Use arrow keys to navigate and Space to select.
designGuide.identicalContentTheThreeButtonsStack: Identical content; the three buttons stack full-width in the order Approve / Deny / Edit & re-sign, and the bindings table uses a 70px label column.
